movelist.name: Withdraw
movelist.effect: The user’s Defense is raised 1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Astonish
movelist.effect: Astonish Flinches the target on 15+. Once per scene, if the target is unaware of the user’s presence, Astonish automatically Flinches the target.

movelist.name: Mega Drain
movelist.effect: After the target takes damage, the user gains Hit Points equal to half of the damage they dealt to the target.

movelist.name: Protect
movelist.effect: If the user is hit by a Move, the user may use Protect. The user is instead not hit by the Move. You do not take any damage nor are you affected by any of the Move’s effects.

movelist.name: Aromatic Mist
movelist.effect: All allies in Aromatic Mist’s area of effect have their Special Defense raised 1 Combat Stage.

abilities.name: Weak Armor
abilities.effect: The user may lower its Defense by 1 Combat Stage, and gain +1 Speed Combat Stage. This is done after the triggering damage is resolved.
